from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import re

# Determine dates from environment
now = datetime.now()
today = now.date()
yesterday = today - timedelta(days=1)

today_title = f"Habit Log -- {today.isoformat()}"
yday_title = f"Habit Log -- {yesterday.isoformat()}"
print('today_title', today_title)
print('yday_title', yday_title)

# Login if needed
creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
pass_map = {c['account_name']: c['password'] for c in creds}
username = 'ma_smith@gmail.com'

if 'simple_note_token' not in globals() or not globals().get('simple_note_token'):
    login_resp = apis.simple_note.login(username=username, password=pass_map['simple_note'])
    simple_note_token = login_resp['access_token']

# Helper pagination

def search_all(query, page_limit=20):
    out=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        resp = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_note_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-created_at')
        if not resp:
            break
        out.extend(resp)
        if len(resp) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1
    return out

# Search for exact title matches
notes_today = search_all(today_title)
exact_today = [n for n in notes_today if n.get('title')==today_title]
print('search_notes(today_title) total', len(notes_today), 'exact', len(exact_today))
print('today candidates:', [(n['note_id'], n.get('created_at')) for n in exact_today])

notes_yday = search_all(yday_title)
exact_yday = [n for n in notes_yday if n.get('title')==yday_title]
print('search_notes(yday_title) total', len(notes_yday), 'exact', len(exact_yday))
print('yday candidates:', [(n['note_id'], n.get('created_at')) for n in exact_yday])

if len(exact_yday)==0:
    # fallback: use broad query 'Habit Log --'
    raise Exception('No exact yesterday habit log found')

# pick newest by created_at for yesterday

def parse_dt(s):
    return s or ''

yday_note = sorted(exact_yday, key=lambda n: parse_dt(n.get('created_at')), reverse=True)[0]
print('selected_yday_note_id', yday_note['note_id'])

# show yesterday content
show_yday = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=yday_note['note_id'], access_token=simple_note_token)
print('yday show keys', show_yday.keys())
print('yday pinned', show_yday.get('pinned'), 'tags', show_yday.get('tags'))
print('yday content snippet:', show_yday['content'][:200])

content = show_yday['content']
# Replace ate_homemade_meals line to yes
new_content, n_subs = re.subn(r"(ate_homemade_meals\s*:\s*)(yes|no)", r"\1yes", content)
print('subs_made', n_subs)
if n_subs==0:
    raise Exception('Could not find ate_homemade_meals line in yesterday content')

# If today note exists, update newest; else create
if len(exact_today)>0:
    today_note = sorted(exact_today, key=lambda n: parse_dt(n.get('created_at')), reverse=True)[0]
    print('updating existing today note_id', today_note['note_id'])
    apis.simple_note.update_note(note_id=today_note['note_id'], access_token=simple_note_token, content=new_content, title=today_title, tags=show_yday.get('tags'), pinned=show_yday.get('pinned'))
    final_note_id = today_note['note_id']
else:
    print('creating new today note')
    create_resp = apis.simple_note.create_note(title=today_title, content=new_content, access_token=simple_note_token, tags=show_yday.get('tags'), pinned=show_yday.get('pinned'))
    print('create_resp', create_resp)
    final_note_id = create_resp['note_id']

final_note_id = int(final_note_id)
print('final_note_id', final_note_id)

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import re

now = datetime.now(); today = now.date(); today_title = f"Habit Log -- {today.isoformat()}"

# Determine final_note_id
final_id = None
if 'final_note_id' in globals() and final_note_id:
    final_id = int(final_note_id)
else:
    # search exact title
    creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords(); pass_map={c['account_name']:c['password'] for c in creds}
    token = None
    login_resp = apis.simple_note.login(username='ma_smith@gmail.com', password=pass_map['simple_note'])
    token = login_resp['access_token']
    def search_all(query, page_limit=20):
        out=[]; i=0
        while True:
            resp = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=token, query=query, page_index=i, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-created_at')
            if not resp: break
            out.extend(resp)
            if len(resp) < page_limit: break
            i+=1
        return out
    candidates = search_all(today_title)
    exact = [n for n in candidates if n.get('title')==today_title]
    print('found_today_candidates', len(candidates), 'exact', len(exact))
    if not exact:
        raise Exception('No today habit log note found')
    final_id = sorted(exact, key=lambda n: n.get('created_at',''), reverse=True)[0]['note_id']

print('final_id', final_id, 'today_title', today_title)

# Need access token for show_note; login again? avoid if possible by reusing simple_note_token if exists
if 'simple_note_token' in globals() and simple_note_token:
    simple_note_token_used = simple_note_token
else:
    creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords(); pass_map={c['account_name']:c['password'] for c in creds}
    login_resp = apis.simple_note.login(username='ma_smith@gmail.com', password=pass_map['simple_note'])
    simple_note_token_used = login_resp['access_token']

shown = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=int(final_id), access_token=simple_note_token_used)
print('shown_title', shown.get('title'))
print('shown_tags', shown.get('tags'))

content = shown.get('content','')

# Extract ate_homemade_meals value
m = re.search(r"ate_homemade_meals\s*:\s*(yes|no)", content)
print('ate_homemade_meals_line_match', m.group(1) if m else None)

# If new_content exists from prior step, compare equality
if 'new_content' in globals() and new_content:
    print('content_equal_new_content', content == new_content)
else:
    print('new_content_not_available')

# Also extract first few lines for sanity
print('content_preview')
print('\n'.join(content.splitlines()[:15]))
